dossier.purpose: Context Hub ('chub', npm package @aisuite/chub 0.1.4) is a Node.js CLI plus a stdio MCP server that lets coding agents search a registry of curated, versioned API/SDK docs and 'skills' (Markdown with YAML frontmatter) and fetch the original DOC.md/SKILL.md text by id. Need 1 (search + read-back): the same package provides `chub search`/`chub get` and MCP tools chub_search/chub_get. Search is lexical only (BM25 over id/name/tags/description plus prefix/fuzzy boosts) over registry metadata; there is no vector or hybrid search and document bodies are not indexed. Bodies are read back from a local folder, the ~/.chub cache, an npm-bundled dist/, or the cdn.aichub.org CDN (human-mode `chub get` appends annotation/feedback/footer text to the body). Controlled ingestion = `chub build <dir>` (validates frontmatter, writes registry.json + search-index.json, copies the tree) plus per-config trust filtering on an author-declared `source` field. Need 2 (difficult-layout document conversion): none. The code has no PDF/scan/Office/EPUB/HTML converter; the repo's content/ only contains skill documentation for the third-party hosted LandingAI ADE service. Repo content: 1,660 DOC.md + 7 SKILL.md files, auto-deployed to the default CDN from main.

claims.claim: Coding agents hallucinate APIs; Context Hub gives them curated, versioned docs plus the ability to get smarter with every task. 'All content is open and maintained as markdown in this repo - you can inspect exactly what your agent reads, and contribute back.'
Quick start: `npm install -g @aisuite/chub`; `chub search openai` ('find what's available'); `chub get openai/chat --lang py` ('fetch current docs (Python version)').

'Chub is designed for your coding agent to use (not for you to use!)'; prompt the agent to run `chub help`, or install the SKILL.md agent skill (Claude Code: create ~/.claude/skills/get-api-docs and put SKILL.md there).
Workflow is 'search, fetch, use': `chub search "stripe payments"` then `chub get stripe/api --lang js`.
Agents can annotate docs locally (`chub annotate stripe/api "..."`); the annotation appears automatically on later `chub get`.
`chub feedback <id> up|down` votes docs up or down; feedback 'flows back to authors' / is 'sent to maintainers'.
Content types are versioned, language-specific docs; 'More content types than API documentation (such as agent skills) are on the roadmap.'
Command table: `chub search [query]` searches docs and skills (no query = list all); `chub get <id> [--lang py|js]` fetches docs or skills by ID.
Incremental fetch: docs can have multiple reference files; `--file` grabs specific references, `--full` fetches everything ('no wasted tokens').
'Content is plain markdown with YAML frontmatter, submitted as pull requests' (format in docs/content-guide.md).
Full command/flag reference lives in docs/cli-reference.md (README links to it).

readme.telemetry_and_network: Telemetry is default-on and opt-out; README.md does not mention it (documented in docs/cli-reference.md:211-219 and SECURITY.md:26-28). (1) PostHog Cloud (https://us.i.posthog.com, hard-coded project key) receives events command_run, first_run, search (raw query text up to 1000 chars + result ids), doc_fetched/skill_fetched (entry id, lang, source, duration), doc_not_found, fetch_error, command_error, feedback_sent, build, each with platform/node_version/cli_version; distinct id = SHA-256 of the machine UUID (macOS ioreg, Linux /etc/machine-id, Windows MachineGuid) saved to ~/.chub/client_id (cli/src/lib/analytics.js:14-15,54-78; cli/src/commands/search.js:101-111; cli/src/mcp/tools.js:74-85; cli/src/lib/identity.js:13-79; cli/src/index.js:64-87). Disable with `telemetry: false` in ~/.chub/config.yaml or CHUB_TELEMETRY=0|false (cli/src/lib/config.js:15; cli/src/lib/telemetry.js:5-9). (2) `chub feedback` / chub_feedback POST rating, labels, free-text comment, agent name/version, CLI version and X-Client-ID to https://api.aichub.org/v1/feedback (3 s timeout); enabled by default, disable with `feedback: false` or CHUB_FEEDBACK=0|false (cli/src/lib/telemetry.js:11-15,41-92); human-mode `chub get` output tells the agent to run chub feedback (cli/src/commands/get.js:171-175). (3) Content network: default source is https://cdn.aichub.org/v1 (config.js:6,51); `search`/`get` auto-refresh registry.json + search-index.json when the cache is older than refresh_interval (code default 21600 s at config.js:12, while docs/cli-reference.md:204 shows 86400) and fetch doc files on demand with 30 s timeouts, falling back to stale cache on failure (cli/src/lib/cache.js:85-147,224-268,385-427). Bare `chub`/`--help`/`help` fetches https://cdn.aichub.org/v1/help/<version>.json (2 s timeout, falls back to bundled text) (cli/src/lib/help.js:175-245). chub itself needs no account or API key and sends no auth header on content fetches (cache.js:85-97); the first-run notice (shown only when stdout and stderr are TTYs, welcome.js:14) says use implies agreement to Terms of Service at https://www.aichub.org/tos.html (cli/src/lib/welcome.js:27; ToS not in repo). With only local `path:` sources no registry/doc/help fetch happens (config.js:27-31,47-48; cache.js:156-158,401-405; help.js:179-181), but passive telemetry must still be disabled. The third-party LandingAI skill content tells agents to call a hosted API with VISION_AGENT_API_KEY (content/landingai/skills/ade/document-extraction/SKILL.md:38-87); that is content, not chub behavior.

languages: JavaScript (Node.js ES modules, no build step, Node >= 18)

entry_points.what: `chub` CLI (Commander): search, get, annotate, feedback, update, cache, build; bare `chub`/--help prints bootstrap help.
stdio MCP server exposing chub_search, chub_get, chub_list, chub_annotate, chub_feedback and resource chub://registry (tool logic in cli/src/mcp/tools.js).
`chub build <content-dir>`: the ingestion/indexing step (discover DOC.md/SKILL.md, validate frontmatter, write registry.json + search-index.json, copy tree).
Merges registries from all sources, applies trust filter, id lookup, searchEntries (BM25 + lexical boosts), resolveDocPath.
Tokenizer, BM25 index build (id/name/tags/description only) and scoring.
Registry/search-index/doc fetching, ~/.chub cache, bundled dist/ seed, optional bundle.tar.gz, fetchDoc (body read-back).
CDN build used by deploy-content.yml (`npm run prepare:cdn`): runs `chub build content/` and writes versioned help JSON.
Packaged agent skill telling agents to run `chub --help`, search, get, annotate and give feedback.

code.architecture: Single npm workspace package cli/ (@aisuite/chub) with two binaries. cli/src/index.js wires Commander commands from cli/src/commands/ (search, get, build, update, cache, annotate, feedback, help); cli/src/mcp/{server,tools,stdio-lifecycle}.js wrap the same lib functions as 5 MCP tools + 1 resource over stdio only. Core lib in cli/src/lib/: registry.js (merge sources, trust filter on `source`, searchEntries = BM25 + Levenshtein/prefix/contains boosts, keyword fallback if no search-index.json), bm25.js (index over id/name/description/tags only; field weights 4/3/1/2 at :22-27), cache.js (remote or local-path reads; cache under ~/.chub/sources/<name>; bundled dist/ seed; fetchDoc order: local path, ~/.chub cache, bundled dist/, CDN), config.js (~/.chub/config.yaml, CHUB_DIR and other env vars), frontmatter.js, annotations.js (one JSON per id in ~/.chub/annotations), analytics.js/telemetry.js/identity.js (PostHog, feedback, machine-hash id), help.js (bootstrap text + remote versioned help). Data model: registry.json {docs[], skills[]} with id author/name, languages[]/versions[]/path/files/size/lastUpdated, and an author-declared trust tier official|maintainer|community; no provenance/source-URL field. Ingestion: build.js walks <content-dir>/<author>/**, only files named DOC.md/SKILL.md become entries (docs need metadata.languages + metadata.versions), then writes registry.json + search-index.json and copies each author dir verbatim except registry.json. Retrieval returns file text as stored; docs require --lang. There is no vector store, embedding, reranker or document-conversion code. CDN content is produced from content/ by scripts/prepare-cdn-build.mjs.
code.packaging_and_release: One artifact: npm package @aisuite/chub 0.1.4 (cli/package.json:2-3) with files bin/, src/, dist/, skills/ (:10-15). dist/ (registry + search index + all content) is built only by the `prepublish` script `chub build ../content -o dist --base-url https://cdn.aichub.org/v1` (cli/package.json:39) and .gitignore excludes it; publish.yml has no explicit build step, so whether the published tarball ships dist/ was not verifiable here. .github/workflows/publish.yml: on GitHub release `created`, runs `npm install` (root), `cd cli && npm test`, polls https://cdn.aichub.org/v1/help/<version>.json until live (30 x 10 s), then `cd cli && npm publish --access public` with secret NPM_TOKEN (publish.yml:3-43). `id-token: write` is granted (:10-12) but there is no --provenance flag/publishConfig, and no checksums, signatures, SBOM or attestations exist anywhere (grep). .github/workflows/deploy-content.yml: on push to main touching content/**, package.json, cli/package.json, cli/src/lib/help.js or scripts/prepare-cdn-build.mjs (or manual dispatch) validates content, runs `npm run prepare:cdn`, `aws s3 sync dist/ s3://$CDN_BUCKET_NAME/v1/ --delete --exclude 'help/*'`, syncs help/, invalidates CloudFront (deploy-content.yml:3-63). CI deletes package-lock.json before installing (ci.yml:20; deploy-content.yml:29); the committed lock still lists the cli workspace as 0.1.3 (package-lock.json:14) vs 0.1.4 in package.json. cli/ has no LICENSE file of its own (root LICENSE only). No binaries, containers or other install artifacts.
code.tests_and_ci: Vitest ^4.0.18 (`npm test` = `vitest run`, cli/package.json:40-42; no vitest config file). 21 test files: cli/test/ (4: e2e.test.js + lib/{bm25,frontmatter,normalize}) and cli/tests/ (17: commands/{build,get,go-lang,search}, lib/{analytics,bm25,cache,config,frontmatter,help,normalize,registry,registry.multisource,registry.search-behavior,welcome}, mcp/{stdio-lifecycle,tools}); about 249 test cases (245 it/itCli matches + 4 itBuild in tests/commands/build.test.js). e2e.test.js spawns the real CLI against cli/test/fixtures with telemetry/feedback disabled. Several MCP tool tests return early when no registry is loaded (cli/tests/mcp/tools.test.js:93,110,131); bm25/frontmatter/normalize tests are duplicated across both test dirs. CI = .github/workflows/ci.yml on push/PR to main, ubuntu-latest, Node 18/20/22 matrix: `rm -f package-lock.json && npm install`; `cd cli && npm test`; `node cli/bin/chub build content/ --validate-only`; `cd cli && npm audit --audit-level=high` (ci.yml:3-23). No lint/type-check, coverage, macOS/Windows or scheduled jobs.
code.dependencies: cli/package.json: 7 runtime deps (@modelcontextprotocol/sdk ^1.27.1, chalk ^5.3.0, commander ^12.0.0, posthog-node ^5.24.17, tar ^7.5.8, yaml ^2.3.0, zod ^4.3.6) + 1 dev dep (vitest ^4.0.18) = 8 direct (cli/package.json:44-55). Root package.json: private workspace root (workspaces: [cli]) with 0 deps (package.json:1-11). Root package-lock.json (lockfileVersion 3) has about 193 node_modules entries (MCP SDK 1.27.1, posthog-node 5.26.2, tar 7.5.11 locked). All pure JS; no native, ML or Python dependencies.
code.security_policy: SECURITY.md exists: report vulnerabilities by opening a public GitHub issue labelled `security` (no private channel), 7-day fix target for critical issues, only 0.1.x supported, scope = @aisuite/chub CLI + api.aichub.org, plus a telemetry note (SECURITY.md:5-28). No Dependabot/Renovate/CodeQL config found.

claim_checks.claim: 'All content is open and maintained as markdown in this repo - you can inspect exactly what your agent reads' (README.md:3)
claim_checks.evidence: content/ holds 1,660 DOC.md + 7 SKILL.md and .github/workflows/deploy-content.yml:3-14,33-52 publishes it to the CDN on push to main, so the source is inspectable. But what an agent receives at runtime is resolved cache-first, then npm-bundled dist/, then CDN (cli/src/lib/cache.js:234-267), no hash/signature verification exists in cli/src (only createHash use is the telemetry id, identity.js:68), and human-mode `chub get` appends annotation + feedback-prompt text to stdout (cli/src/commands/get.js:159-181).

claim_checks.claim: `chub search` finds what's available / searches docs and skills (README.md:13,54)
claim_checks.evidence: cli/src/commands/search.js:50-121 -> cli/src/lib/registry.js:327-419: BM25 (cli/src/lib/bm25.js:195-287; field weights id 4/name 3/tags 2/description 1 at :22-27) plus Levenshtein/prefix/contains boosts (registry.js:26-153), keyword-count fallback when no search-index.json (registry.js:362-389). Scope caveat: the index is built only from id/name/description/tags (bm25.js:170-190; build.js:313-319), so bodies are not searchable, and no vector/hybrid/rerank code exists anywhere in cli/ (grep for embedding/vector/semantic/rerank is empty).

claim_checks.claim: `chub get <id> [--lang py|js]` fetches docs or skills by ID (README.md:14,55)
claim_checks.evidence: Fetch works for docs and skills (cli/src/commands/get.js:13-100; cli/src/mcp/tools.js:97-193) and returns the stored file text via fetchDoc (cache.js:224-268). But for docs --lang is effectively mandatory: resolveDocPath returns needsLanguage whenever no lang is given (registry.js:492-500), the option text says '(required for docs)' (get.js:205), and an e2e test asserts an error for a single-language doc without --lang (cli/test/e2e.test.js:319-322). Skills need no --lang.

claim_checks.claim: Language is auto-inferred when a doc has only one variant / --lang not required (docs/cli-reference.md:57,101, linked from README.md:61; MCP schema text at cli/src/mcp/server.js:57)
claim_checks.evidence: Code contradicts the docs (code wins): registry.js:492-500 returns needsLanguage for any doc without lang regardless of language count; CLI errors (get.js:54-59); MCP errors with 'Multiple languages available' even for one language (tools.js:137-141); e2e test 'errors on single-lang doc without --lang' (cli/test/e2e.test.js:319-322). Only `chub feedback` infers a sole language (cli/src/commands/feedback.js:97-100).

claim_checks.claim: Incremental fetch: `--file` for specific references, `--full` for everything (README.md:86)
claim_checks.evidence: CLI: get.js:71-92 (--file list validated against the registry's files at :74-78; --full at :86-88; additionalFiles footer at :176-180 and in JSON at :161). MCP chub_get supports file/full (tools.js:150-167) but traversal-checks only `file` (:100-106) and does not list reference files on success. Caveat: `--json` returns no body for multi-id/--full/multi-file fetches, only id/type/path (get.js:185-196).

claim_checks.claim: Content is plain markdown with YAML frontmatter, submitted as PRs (README.md:94); skills are 'on the roadmap' (README.md:48)
claim_checks.evidence: Build discovers only files named DOC.md/SKILL.md and parses YAML frontmatter (cli/src/commands/build.js:20-31,75-87); it errors only on missing name and, for docs, missing metadata.languages/metadata.versions (:79-82,128-135). docs/content-guide.md:130-139 marks revision, updated-on and source as required but the code does not enforce them (source defaults to 'community', updated-on to today: build.js:90-92,98-100; revision is never read). Skills are already implemented (build.js:102-118; 7 SKILL.md under content/) despite README.md:48. CI validates content via `chub build content/ --validate-only` (ci.yml:22).

claim_checks.claim: Telemetry is anonymous, 'No personally identifiable information is collected', and can be disabled (docs/cli-reference.md:213-219; SECURITY.md:28; README.md is silent)
claim_checks.evidence: Opt-out works: `telemetry: false` or CHUB_TELEMETRY=0|false (cli/src/lib/telemetry.js:5-9). But it is default-on (cli/src/lib/config.js:15), keyed to a SHA-256 of the machine UUID stored at ~/.chub/client_id (identity.js:13-79), and sends free-text search queries (up to 1000 chars) plus result and entry ids to PostHog (analytics.js:14-15,54-78; search.js:101-111; tools.js:74-85). SECURITY.md:28 points to docs/design.md for identifier details that it does not contain (grep of docs/ finds none); design.md:546 lists telemetry as a future item.

claim_checks.claim: `chub update --full` downloads the full bundle for offline use (docs/cli-reference.md:147; docs/design.md:359,370)
claim_checks.evidence: Consumer exists: fetchFullBundle GETs <source.url>/bundle.tar.gz and extracts it with tar (cli/src/lib/cache.js:171-219; cli/src/commands/update.js:17-31). Nothing in the repo produces bundle.tar.gz: `chub build` writes only registry.json, search-index.json and the content tree (build.js:309-330), scripts/prepare-cdn-build.mjs and deploy-content.yml sync dist/ only (:36-52), and no tar-creation code exists. Offline use otherwise relies on the npm-bundled dist/ seed (cache.js:410-423), whose presence in the published package was not verifiable.

claim_checks.claim: Your own docs 'work exactly like the public ones' via a local `sources:` path + `chub build` (docs/byod-guide.md:5-68)
claim_checks.evidence: Local path sources are supported, read directly without caching (config.js:47-48; cache.js:224-232,287-292) and searched with the build's search-index.json when present (cache.js:304-313; registry.js:354-361). But the guide's example frontmatter puts languages/versions/tags at top level (byod-guide.md:24-34) whereas build.js reads them from `metadata.*` (build.js:87,121-135), so by code reading the example fails `chub build` validation (not executed). Remote sources cannot carry credentials (cache.js:85-97) and docs/private-content.md:3 says team distribution is 'Coming Soon'.

claim_checks.claim: Annotations are local notes that persist and appear automatically on future `chub get` (README.md:29-35)
claim_checks.evidence: Stored as one JSON file per id under ~/.chub/annotations (cli/src/lib/annotations.js:5-12,22-32), appended to output by the CLI (get.js:159-169) and by MCP chub_get (tools.js:169-173); e2e tests cover it (cli/test/e2e.test.js:435-493). docs/features/agent-annotations.md describes a different, unimplemented design (markdown files, --type, --no-annotations, `chub annotations` subcommands); none of these exist in cli/src (grep).

risks: Scope vs. the stated needs: search is lexical-only and metadata-only (id/name/tags/description); doc bodies are never indexed and there is no vector/hybrid/rerank code (cli/src/lib/bm25.js:170-190; cli/src/commands/build.js:313-319). Only files named DOC.md/SKILL.md become entries (build.js:20-31). There is no PDF/scan/Office/EPUB/HTML conversion in code; the only document-parsing material is third-party skill text for the hosted LandingAI ADE service, which needs VISION_AGENT_API_KEY and whose format list omits EPUB and HTML inputs (content/landingai/skills/ade/document-extraction/SKILL.md:10-14,38-87; references/file-formats.md:9-15). The registry schema has no per-entry source-URL/provenance field; `source` is only a trust tier (docs/design.md:437-445).

Body fidelity and staleness: fetchDoc serves the ~/.chub cache first, then the npm-bundled dist/ copy, and only then the CDN, with no invalidation on registry refresh and no hash/signature check of any fetched file (cli/src/lib/cache.js:224-268; no integrity code in cli/src). Bundled paths also shadow same-path files from other remote sources. Human-mode `chub get` appends annotation text, feedback-prompt lines and an additional-files footer to the body (cli/src/commands/get.js:159-181); raw bodies need `--json` (single entry only, get.js:185-196 returns no body for multi-id/--full/multi-file) or `-o`. MCP chub_get appends the annotation and does not list reference files (cli/src/mcp/tools.js:149-173). --lang is mandatory for docs (registry.js:492-500).

Privacy: telemetry and feedback are default-on and README.md does not mention them. Every non-help command sends PostHog events including raw search query text (up to 1000 chars), result ids and entry ids, tied to a SHA-256 machine-UUID id (cli/src/lib/analytics.js:14-15,54-78; cli/src/commands/search.js:101-111; cli/src/index.js:64-87; cli/src/lib/identity.js:66-79; cli/src/lib/config.js:15-16). `chub feedback`/chub_feedback POST free-text comments, agent name/version and the client id to api.aichub.org (cli/src/lib/telemetry.js:52-78), and CLI output nudges agents to send feedback (get.js:171-175; cli/src/lib/help.js:114-117). The ToS/feedback notice only shows when stdout and stderr are TTYs (cli/src/lib/welcome.js:14), so non-interactive agent runs never see it; the ToS it cites (https://www.aichub.org/tos.html) is not in the repo. Opt-outs: telemetry:false / CHUB_TELEMETRY=0 and feedback:false / CHUB_FEEDBACK=0.

Agent instructions can change without a release: bare `chub`/`--help`/`help` fetches https://cdn.aichub.org/v1/help/<version>.json at runtime and prints it (cli/src/lib/help.js:175-245); docs say it 'can be revised over time to tune prompting for that same binary' (docs/cli-reference.md:30-32); the packaged skill tells agents to run `chub --help` and follow it over the skill's own text on conflict (cli/skills/get-api-docs/SKILL.md:12-13,40-41,52-53). The CDN is updated automatically on push to main (.github/workflows/deploy-content.yml:3-14,41-52). Mitigation: `help_url: off` or CHUB_HELP_URL=off (help.js:3-16).

Release and supply-chain hygiene is minimal: npm publish uses a long-lived NPM_TOKEN with no --provenance flag even though id-token: write is granted (.github/workflows/publish.yml:10-13,41-43); no checksums, signatures, SBOM or attestations; no Dependabot/Renovate/CodeQL. CI deletes package-lock.json before installing (ci.yml:20; deploy-content.yml:29), the committed lock lists the cli workspace as 0.1.3 vs 0.1.4 (package-lock.json:14; cli/package.json:3), and runtime deps use caret ranges (cli/package.json:44-52). dist/ is built only by the `prepublish` script (cli/package.json:39) and publish.yml has no build step, so whether the tarball ships dist/ is unverified. SECURITY.md asks reporters to open a public GitHub issue (SECURITY.md:5).

Thin trust model: the `source` tier used by the trust filter is author-declared in frontmatter and unverified (cli/src/commands/build.js:90; cli/src/lib/registry.js:269-273). Registry-supplied `path`/`files` are joined into filesystem paths with no containment check for reads and cache writes (cli/src/lib/cache.js:226-267), so a hostile or compromised registry.json from any configured source could read or write outside the cache dir (code reading only, not exercised); MCP validates only its own `file` argument (cli/src/mcp/tools.js:100-106). Remote sources cannot carry credentials (cache.js:85-97,252). `chub build` copies every file under each author dir except registry.json into the output, so stray files get published (build.js:321-330).

Platform and test gaps: CI is ubuntu-latest only (ci.yml:11) with a Node 18/20/22 matrix, but vitest@4.0.18 requires Node ^20 || ^22 || >=24 (package-lock.json:2610-2612) and two test files use import.meta.dirname (cli/tests/commands/build.test.js:7; cli/tests/lib/cache.test.js:6), so the Node 18 leg's outcome is unverified; no macOS/Windows/WSL jobs, no lint or type check. Several MCP tool tests return early when no registry is loaded and so pass vacuously (cli/tests/mcp/tools.test.js:93,110,131). On minimal Linux containers lacking /etc/machine-id and /var/lib/dbus/machine-id the client-id helper throws (cli/src/lib/identity.js:23-29); passive telemetry swallows it (cli/src/index.js:84-86) but sendFeedback does not (cli/src/lib/telemetry.js:44-45).

Maintenance and doc drift: pre-1.0 (0.1.4), only 0.1.x supported (SECURITY.md:18-20); the clone is shallow so commit cadence is not assessable. Docs diverge from code on single-language auto-infer, the bundle.tar.gz producer, the version flag (code is `-V, --cli-version`, cli/src/index.js:53, vs docs/cli-reference.md:10), the refresh_interval default (21600 at config.js:12 vs 86400 example at cli-reference.md:204), the unimplemented docs/features/search-ranking.md and agent-annotations.md, the BYOD frontmatter, and a stale 'chub-first-draft' tree in docs/design.md:504-531. The MCP server is undocumented, refreshes the registry only at startup, and memoizes the registry/search index at first use, so a long-running chub-mcp will not see rebuilt or updated sources until restarted (cli/src/mcp/server.js:170-174; cli/src/lib/registry.js:6-7,194-195). content/ has no per-entry upstream license/attribution metadata or NOTICE file (CONTRIBUTING.md:127 just says contributions are MIT) and cli/ has no LICENSE file of its own.
